title: The way in
goals: Do it in fewer than 11 lines.
starting_code: # The gate listens, the wand waits, and two doors are sealed.
hints: Go one door at a time: what does each door want?
The wand lies beyond the gate. The seals come after it.
Count the tiles of each stretch, so that each one is a single line with its number.
intro: This is the way into the castle. A gate that listens, a wand to find, and two seals. Everything you have learned, together.
outro: You are in, {wizard}! This is the castle of Arvelia. Tomorrow, the library.
